sourcePriority: Selected case content from Training Cases (June 2026).pptx
Embedded guidance and mapped concepts from the July 2026 course deck
Assessment interaction rules from Course Assistant Prompt 4.0
assessmentPrinciples: Assess reasoning against the selected case and mapped course content only.
Accept concise bullet answers and equivalent professional wording.
Do not require essays and do not penalize wording where reasoning is correct.
Do not introduce external theories, facts, or frameworks.
Provide feedback mapped to every main case question. Do not generate challenge or follow-up questions.

CASE-02: Do not require or reward a numerical opportunity-cost calculation.
Do not deduct points because the student does not calculate or mention GBP 62.5 million.
The GBP 62.5 million calculation is tutor/background material and is not part of the student-facing evidence or score-bearing rubric.

Assess opportunity cost conceptually: lost revenue, disruption, customer trust, operational damage, foregone retained internal capability, resilience and service continuity are valid answers when linked to the case.

Assess the recommendation by whether the student balances apparent TCO savings against operational risk, continuity, control and risk-adjusted TCO; selective or hybrid outsourcing is a valid recommendation when reasoned from the case.
A score of 5 does not require any numerical opportunity-cost figure.
